The system must allow a customer to place an order and track its progression through Processing, Shipped, and Delivered states. 
Crucially, the system must allow cancellation only within 60 minutes of placement, automatically block late cancellations in the Processing state, 
and automatically flag or cancel the order if payment fails, stock errors occur, or delivery cannot be completed after 5 days.
